findings.highlight: It's too bad that I didn't have any potatoes on hand
findings.evidenceJa: 肉じゃがなのにじゃがいもだけをつつかれる
findings.governingReading: She bites sweet-cooked potatoes, and he regrets her taking only potato pieces from the meat-and-potato dish.
findings.explanation: Illya eating only the potatoes becomes there having been no potatoes.

findings.highlight: the pot in the middle of the table.
findings.evidenceJa: 真ん中に盛り付けられた大皿
findings.governingReading: 大皿 is the shared serving platter in the table’s middle.
findings.explanation: A large serving dish becomes a pot.

findings.highlight: Unless there's some secret ingredient that makes this one different from the rest.
findings.evidenceJa: 隠し味らしきものが入ってるから他のとは違う
findings.governingReading: Rin says it differs because something like a hidden seasoning is in it; her uncertainty concerns the ingredient’s character.
findings.explanation: An apparent secret ingredient explaining difference becomes an unless exception.

findings.governingReading: 納得のいかない顔 is her unconvinced expression before tasting again.

findings.highlight: She even asked for a third helping.
findings.governingReading: おかわりを三杯 is three refills beyond the initial serving, an achieved appetite demonstration.
findings.explanation: Three extra helpings become asking for a third helping.

findings.highlight: until we completely finished all of the food and rice.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は美味しそうに箸を進め、綺麗さっぱりおかずと米を片付けてくれた
findings.governingReading: 桜 remains subject of eating and 片付けてくれた while Rin watches surprised.
findings.explanation: Sakura finishing the food and rice becomes the whole group finishing it.
